law_record.title: Speed contests (A)
law_record.text: No person shall engage in any motor vehicle speed contest or exhibition of power or speed on a highway and no person shall aid or abet in any such motor vehicle speed contest or exhibition upon any highway.

activation_conditions: the subject engages in, or aids or abets, a motor vehicle speed contest or exhibition of power or speed on a highway
residue: a contest is defined by the drivers' shared intention, which is interior state; the observable substitute is coordinated acceleration and repeated passing
'aid or abet' is participation by another person, weaker still in observation
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: a contest is an episode between two or more vehicles: the trace must cover enough of it to show the joint behaviour, not one fast vehicle
the coordination is judged over that window
